conclusion: The available evidence presents multiple conflicting claims across several key project aspects, preventing a definitive determination of the true facts. No single claim can be confirmed as accurate without additional corroborating evidence.
evidence_gaps: Insufficient data to resolve the exact beta release date and any subsequent delays.
Lack of a consistent record of the maximum team size and membership changes over time.
No reliable source to confirm the accurate cumulative spending figures for July, August, and September 2024.
Unclear which source correctly reports the incident date (October 12 vs. October 14).
Disagreement on the number of customer accounts affected by the incident (27 vs. 37).
No definitive evidence to determine whether the Nova Support Platform was truly ready for production or still had unresolved critical performance issues.
No conclusive information on whether the project was completed in December 2024 or if the production launch was postponed to February 2025.
